messages:
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled for HarborBlue dedicated slice starting 2025-03-22 02:30 UTC (in 20m). image: rwd-inference/dedicated-runtime:v2.14-quant pinned for tenant harbor-blue. canary = 10% traffic -> 1h observation window.
elena: ack. I reviewed the release notes: https://internal.redwood.com/releases/harborblue-2025-03-22 (minor model weight update, quantization profile B).
chris: quick check — KMS rotation conflict? our rotation is scheduled at 03:00 UTC. if that runs during rollout it could block decrypt for a few minutes.
raj: @chris good catch. ops has a manual hold on KMS rotations for scheduled deploys. @ops-bot can you confirm hold is set for 02:00-04:00 UTC for HarborBlue?
ops-bot: hold applied for KMS rotations: 2025-03-22T01:45:00Z -> 2025-03-22T04:15:00Z. notifier set to @sre and @security.
katie: rolling window looks green. canary health checks:
- p50 latency < 120ms
- 5xx rate < 0.5%
- success rate > 99.2%
if any of these breach for 3 consecutive 1m buckets, auto-rollback triggers.
elena: add one more: semantic-regression > 1.5% on smoke prompts -> manual rollback, notify product and ML.
chris: SLA note — customer requested pin to v2.14-quant (no auto-upgrades) until end of quarter. ops, ensure version pin is enforced in tenant config.
ops-bot: tenant config updated: model_pin = v2.14-quant, auto_patch = false. config push confirmed.
deploy-bot: starting canary slice now (slice-id cb-canary-7). logs: /var/logs/deploys/1751239876-canary.log
elena: watching metrics dashboard -> https://grafana.internal/r/redwood/harborblue/canary
raj: seeing slight increase 95th latency to ~210ms for a span, but p50 OK. marking as watchful. anyone seeing errors?
katie: small spike in token decoding errors on replica 3, traced to quant path mismatch. initiating warm restart of replica 3.
ops-bot: replica 3 restarted, kv-cache warm restored, no error increase after restart.
chris: canary observation window elapsed 35m. metrics within thresholds except the earlier brief 95th spike. recommend proceed to phased ramp to 50% over next 30m.
elena: +1 from ML (checked sample outputs vs release evals, no quality regression). proceeding.
raj: @oncall please acknowledge — if error rate > 1% at any point, you have authority to abort and trigger rollback.
oncall: acknowledged. I'll monitor for the next 90m.
deploy-bot: Traffic ramping to 50% now (policy: linear over 30m). next check at 10m intervals.
katie: note for post-deploy — add a log filter to capture token-level OOMs in the first 24h in case of rare memory regressions.
elena: adding to release notes and alerting support. docs link updated.
chris: final check: rollback plan? steps:
1) deploy-bot: switch tenant model_pin to v2.13-oq (previous stable)
2) traffic revert to 100% v2.13-oq
3) open incident and notify customer success
4) schedule postmortem if outage > 5 min
elena: acknowledged. escalation contacts: elena, chris, raj, katie.
deploy-bot: canary -> ramp complete to 50%. monitoring.
ops-bot: KMS rotation hold will be cleared at 04:15 UTC unless extended.
oncall: saw a transient error spike at 02:58 UTC (0.9% 5xx for 2m) — but it dropped. holding.
elena: okay proceed to full ramp to 100% over next hour, unless we see another sustained spike.
katie: starting 100% ramp now (phased: 50% -> 75% -> 100% over 60m). will report after each step.
raj: thumbs up. thanks team :thumbsup: 
deploy-bot: ramp to 75% complete.
chris: ramp to 100% complete. tenant config stable. closing this rollout thread; will append final notes and timeline in release doc.
ops-bot: final state: HarborBlue model: v2.14-quant active. no rollbacks. incident = none.
